body:
Whoever said this was a good combo is not mistaken.  I had excellent cannabis (1st generation sativa/indica hybrid) and this made the ride more intense and very lucid.  This cannabis barely makes the eyes red though it's completely overpowering.
Before smoking the cannabis, the 5-HTP initially came on and felt a bit like the 'coming up' part of MDMA, though milder.  Still, noticeable (this was 2 pills).  So I doubled the dose and I think that was plenty--the weed took on a deeper, more lucid quality.  COlors seems much more clear and surfaces looked more 'active'.  All redness of the eyes was gone, in fact I looked stone cold sober!
